## Competitive Landscape

| Competitor | Strengths | Company Advantage |
|-----------|-----------|------------------|
| Competitor A (oral flea/tick) | Brand recognition, oral flea/tick | Broader portfolio, price point |
| Competitor B (market leader) | Market leader, wide range | Dedicated animal health focus, service |
| Competitor C (retail-strong) | Strong retail presence | Vet-exclusive relationship, margins |
| Competitor D (long-acting) | Long-acting (12 weeks) | Monthly engagement, compliance programs |

### Company Differentiators
1. **100% Animal Health Focus** — Not a side business of a human pharma company
2. **Partner Approach** — Dedicated rep support, training, marketing materials
3. **Clinic Margins** — Competitive pricing that protects clinic profitability
4. **Compliance Programs** — Tools to help clinics build recurring prevention revenue
5. **Product Range** — Parasiticides + dental + dermatology = one supplier relationship
